args.title: Saltmarsh freight blog + companion — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/freight/companion):

- This quarter, freight spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least (per the companion piece).
